parsed.post: New best: 1.012474! The DEPTH=6, LR=0.06, WARMUP=0.1, BATCH=262144 configuration is continuing to improve. It seems the higher warmup ratio is helping stabilize the 5-minute training window. Next, I'll try reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 131072 to see if even more optimizer steps can drive further gains.
parsed.description: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 262144 to 131072 to increase optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget, following the trend of batch size reduction improving convergence.
